findings.claim: At observed selection node landmark_00, the signed favorable-minus-comparison contrast is positive and significant for the soft_mass component (effect_z=0.639, q=1.9e-4, positive_batch_fraction=1.0), indicating selection enrichment of soft mass at that node.

At landmark_00 the local_dy and local_cyy contrasts are negative and significant (effect_z=-0.301, q=9.7e-3 and effect_z=-0.575, q=1.3e-4 respectively), with low positive_batch_fraction (0.071 and 0.0), indicating depletion of these signed coordinate components at the selection node.

The local_cxx contrast at landmark_00 is negative and significant (effect_z=-0.579, q=1.8e-3), while local_dz is not distinguishable from zero (effect_z=-0.024, q=0.868), so the signed contrast is component-specific rather than a uniform geometric shift.

These regional_effects rows are label-bound enrichment contrasts (measure=enrichment_z) at observed selection nodes; they quantify selection enrichment, not an absolute geometric descriptor of the population.

hypotheses.direction: soft_mass positive; local_dy, local_cyy, local_cxx negative
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-measured contrast at the same node with sign reversal or q above the declared threshold.
hypotheses.observable: enrichment_z signed contrast per component at landmark_00
hypotheses.scope: observed selection nodes within the observed window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes are component-specific, with soft_mass enriched and local_dy/local_cyy/local_cxx depleted at landmark_00.

limitations: Only regional contrast evidence is supplied in this isolated interface probe; no outcome or affinity data are available.
Effect_z signs are definition-bound per observable and cannot be compared across observables as a shared quality axis.
The complete observed window is represented only by the delivered rows read here; no claim is made about unread regions or nodes.
No causal or physical-interaction interpretation is supported by these coordinate contrasts.
